preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer t (1 ≤ t ≤ 10^5) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(n.is_integer() and 2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in [int(line) for line in stdin.splitlines()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line is an integer n (2 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) representing the array length.

preconditions.expression: all(all(a_i.is_integer() and 1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in map(int, line.split())) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2::2])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains n integers a_i (1 ≤ a_i ≤ 10^9) representing the array elements.
The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2·10^5.

postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is the maximum possible sum of the final array after performing zero or more operations, where each operation replaces a subarray a[i..j] with |a[i] - a[j]| repeated (j-i+1) times.

postconditions.expression: all(max_sum(a) == sum(a) if all(x == a[0] for x in a) else max(sum(a), max_sum(a[1:]), max_sum(a[:-1]), max_sum(a[0] + [abs(a[0] - a[-1])] * len(a))), for a in test_cases)
postconditions.description: The maximum sum is either the sum of the original array (if all elements are equal) or the maximum of: (1) the sum of the original array, (2) the maximum sum of the array without the first element, (3) the maximum sum of the array without the last element, or (4) the sum of the array where the entire array is replaced by |a[0] - a[-1]| repeated n times.
